cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 92 since November 2022. Owns Hammett Drilling and has worked as a cattleman, poultry producer and water well contractor. Wikipedia says he chaired the Covington County Commission from 1995 to 2020.
cands.gaps: We found no documented sponsored bills or actions in office that we could tie to specific issues. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026, so we found no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. We found no public stances on data centers or development, no documented controversies, no foreign ties and no endorsements. Where he was raised and when he came to Alabama are not documented. His years as Covington County Commission chairman come from a single Wikipedia page, with no corroborating local source.
